description: This file contains serializers and copiers for the Stack<T> class in Orleans Serialization framework. It includes a StackCodec<T> class for serializing/deserializing Stack<T> objects, and a StackCopier<T> class for creating deep copies of Stack<T>. The purpose is to enable efficient serialization and copying of stack data structures within Orleans.

classes.name: StackCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer for Stack<T>, handling serialization and deserialization processes.

classes.name: StackCopier<T>
classes.description: Provides deep copying functionality for Stack<T> instances.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a Stack<T> into a binary writer.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes data from a reader into a Stack<T> instance.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a Stack<T> in the context.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs deep copy of Stack<T> from input to output with context.
